title: Glowing windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c2' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd465' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb033' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- hill -->
  <path d='M0 92 Q25 78 50 84 Q75 90 100 80 L100 100 L0 100 Z' fill='#2f8f6f'/>
  <path d='M0 92 Q25 78 50 84 Q75 90 100 80' fill='none' stroke='#5fd3a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <path d='M42 84 L46 50 L54 50 L58 84 Z' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <path d='M44 84 L44 50 L46 50 L46 84 Z' fill='#f7e3b8'/>

  <rect x='47' y='72' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#b0703a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='72' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d99a5e'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='3' fill='#ffde6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.4' fill='#fff6c9'/>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='5' fill='#c99a5f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#ffe28a'/>
  <!-- sails -->
  <g stroke-linecap='round'>
    <g>
      <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='3.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='67' y2='22' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='65' y2='29' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='63' y2='36' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='rotate(90 50 46)'>
      <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='3.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='67' y2='22' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='65' y2='29' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='63' y2='36' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='rotate(180 50 46)'>
      <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='3.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='67' y2='22' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='65' y2='29' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='63' y2='36' stroke='#f2d38f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='rotate(270 50 46)'>
      <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='3.5'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='67' y2='22' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff2b0'>
    <path d='M20 30 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 Z'/>
